{{Quote|We secured House Palerma's villa, which the Jedi had been using as a command post.|[[Darth Malgus]]|<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
'''House Palerma''' was a family that resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] used House Palerma's villa as a command post and in about [[3661 BBY]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconsituted Sith Empire]] [[Battle of Serenno|attacked]] Serenno and captured the villa.
